Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

volleyball noun

the game

also play volleyball, spike the ball

modern

Traupman 51, 402

lūdus follis volātilis

“The game of the flying ball”; “play volleyball” is folle volātilī lūdere.

Other words

  • volātifollium, volātifolliī n.

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Andresian p. 19 · Declension on Wiktionary

    Andresian’s one-word name, formed like pedifollium.

  • follis pugillāris

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. volleyball; Traupman 402

    Morgan–Owens’s choice, “the ball struck with the fist”, after Vives’s pugnō, ut follēs: he finds “flying ball” a poor description of the game.

Examples

  • follem magnā vī prōpellere

    spike the ballTraupman 51

See also volleyball, ball, net.
